questions: How long does the Ecolab Oasis 146 sanitizing spray need to sit on the buffet counter before I wipe it off
sanitize sanitizer sanitization clean cleaning cleaner all
queries.answer: You must let the surface stay wet for at least 60 seconds before wiping. Do not dry immediately.

questions: What is the mix ratio of the Ecolab Oasis 146 sanitizing spray
sanitize sanitizer sanitization clean cleaning cleaner all
queries.answer: Mix 0.25oz of Ecolab Oasis 146 per gallon of warm water (150-400 ppm).

questions: What should I do if a guest spills hot coffee on the carpet during an active executive board meeting
emergency drink accident accidentally floor spill all
queries.answer:
Sorry to hear about a spill in the workplace.

Here is a discreet, rapid response plan to handle the accident quietly and safely without disrupting the meeting.
items: Enter quietly through a door in the rear of the room
Hand the guest a dry linen napkin immediately
Blot (do not rub) the carpet using an emergency microfiber pad
Apply neutral spot remover after the meeting wraps up
